name: Marshmallow
author: The Wickham family
steps: Add 1/2 c water to sugar and simmer until soft ball stage.
Cool and add remaining water in which gelatine has been soaked.
Quickly pour into a flat wet 9 inch square dish.
When set cut inot squares with a wet knife and roll in toasted coconut.

culture.text: Marshmallow is a confection made from sugar, water and gelatin whipped to a solid-but-soft consistency. It is used as a filling in baking or molded into shapes and coated with corn starch. This sugar confection is inspired by a medicinal confection made from Althaea officinalis, the marsh-mallow plant.
